arStrings.szText: This Mega Bundle includes "Era Apocalyptika" Warlock equipment, "The Fallen Rapture" Rogue equipment, "Sacrilege's Crucible" Paladin equipment, "The Abyssal Revival" Necromancer equipment, "The Claws of Baal" Spiritborn equipment, "Singer of Anathema" Sorcerer equipment, "Bellows of Netherfire" Druid equipment, "The Flames of Abaddon" Barbarian equipment, "Astride the Fell Horde" mount and mount armor, and "Demonic Goods" weapons.
